title: Business English Conversation 43:  Picking Up a Client
content: 1. to pick up someone from the airport: to go to the airport and get a person and then take them somewhere else - I need to pick up the client from the airport. - Can you pick me up from the airport tomorrow morning? 2. a client: a customer who uses the professional services of a business or who does business with a company - She is currently meeting a client. - Our accounting firm has over 200 clients. 3. a flight schedule: the times that an airplane will depart and arrive - My flight schedule has been changed. - What is your flight schedule?
